description: Backend and frontend teams need to confirm that paginated API response samples keep page, offset, and cursor behavior consistent across endpoints and edge cases.

page_size.description: Optional. If provided, must be a positive integer. Used to verify per-page item counts and boundary transitions.

pagination_mode.description: Select the intended pagination contract. 'mixed' means samples may contain more than one pagination style and the checker will verify consistency within each style.

response_samples.description: Must contain one or more API response samples in JSON text form. Each sample must parse as an object or array. Empty input is invalid.

show_item_paths.description: When true, output item path references for duplicates, gaps, and boundary findings when they can be inferred from the samples.

sort_key.description: Optional. If provided, must be a non-empty field path such as 'created_at' or 'data.items[].id'. Used as the expected stable ordering key across samples.

name: api-pagination-and-cursor-consistency-checker
title: API Pagination and Cursor Consistency Checker
